**blackice** (beta), an [MV3 API-based](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/mv3/intro/) ad and tracker blocker.

## Installation

- Chromium-based browsers: download the `blackice.beta.chromium.zip` below, unzip, then load unpacked via `chrome://extensions` → Developer mode.
